text:
maya: Heads-up — after shipping python-sdk 0.8.1 I'm seeing connection leaks in the async client under high concurrency. Latency spikes and fd exhaustion on ingestion workers. Repro below.

sam: Which client exactly? Async or sync?

maya: AsyncClient. We're reusing one client across ~200 coroutines. After upgrade from 0.8.0 -> 0.8.1 sockets pile up (many TIME_WAIT/ESTABLISHED). Also random `ResourceWarning: unclosed session`. Repro snippet:```py
async with RedwoodAsyncClient(api_key=KEY) as c:
    tasks = [c.generate("input") for _ in range(200)]
    await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
```

liam: If you're creating a new client per request that will leak. But you said reusing one caused it too?

maya: Right — even reusing a client we still saw leak after the bump. lsof shows tons of connections to inference.redwood.ai. Stacktrace points to aiohttp connector.

nora: Can you paste the ResourceWarning stack and output of `lsof -p <pid>`? Also which aiohttp version?

maya: Stack points into `aiohttp.connector.TCPConnector._cleanup()`. We're on aiohttp 3.8.4.

sam: I tried a tiny repro and can trigger it:```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
import asyncio
async def bomb():
  c = AsyncClient(api_key=\"XXX\")
  await asyncio.gather(*[c.generate('x') for _ in range(500)])

asyncio.run(bomb())
```
Same fd leak.

liam: Sounds like default connector params changed in 0.8.1 (maybe `limit` unset). Opening a bug: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/789

devx-bot: New issue opened: #789 Connection pooling leak in AsyncClient (by liam)

nora: Quick proposal: ensure AsyncClient exposes an explicit `close()` coroutine and that we implement `__aenter__/__aexit__` to always `await self._session.close()`; add a `max_concurrent_requests` config (default 100) and use an internal semaphore to gate calls. Also add integration test to assert connector count returns to baseline.

sam: Also surface these fixes in typing — right now some async methods are `-> Any` so IDEs don't show `close()` or context manager usage well. Typing improvements would prevent misuse.

maya: For mitigation we switched to `async with` per request temporarily and it reduced leaks. But docs need a recommended pattern for long-lived clients.

liam: Working on PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 — includes fix + pytest-asyncio test that tracks open connectors. Adds config options: `max_connections` and `max_concurrent_requests` (semaphore). Will cut 0.8.2 patch.

maya: Can we also add a short quickstart snippet showing the preferred pattern for a shared AsyncClient + semaphore?

nora: 👍 I'll add changelog entry + a warning if user triggers >1000 concurrent coroutines without an explicit pool.

devx-bot: Release note drafted for 0.8.2: connection pool fixes, semaphore-based concurrency control, and typing improvements.

sam: Follow-up: after PR lands, let's add a small benchmark (concurrency vs latency vs socket count) to CI so future regressions are obvious.

maya: Agreed — thanks all, keep me posted.
